card.name: Words just before a fixed phrase continues
card.fires_on: The word "only" in "should be used during pregnancy only if the potential benefit justifies", and a few other points where a stock phrase is about to continue. Also commas and equals signs in set label text.

modes.label: Pregnancy 'only if'
modes.description: The word "only" after "used during pregnancy" in standard pregnancy-use wording.
modes.example: Etodolac tablets should be used during pregnancy<< only>> if the potential benefit justifies the potential

modes.description: The comma after "In the last 6 months" in a contraindication list.
modes.example: 4 CONTRAINDICATIONS PONVORY is contraindicated in patients who: In the last 6 months<<,>> have experienced myocardial infarction,

modes.label: Formula or old-money text
modes.description: The equals sign in a creatinine clearance formula, or the word "shillings" in a currency description.
